title: Jelly Roll Morton: style and personality
summary: Morton was creative, ragtime-rooted, and got along well with the Red Hot Peppers though he argued with outsiders.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Remembering Jelly Roll Morton: the man, the band

blocks.x: There's one other question I might ask you, which is, sorry to put you on the spot too. Can you tell us anything about Jelly Roll? How do you like this style of playing?
Well, Jelly was very creative. And he came up during the ragtime era. So I guess you would call his style more towards the ragtime style, you know.
Was he easy to get along with, personally? Well, with us he was.
Yeah, we got along with him nicely. But with outsiders probably arguments would come up. But with all of us, the Red Hot Peppers, we got along very good with him.
The musicians that he understood and that he was trying to do. Yeah, that's right.
